payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_a_probe_cell_that_stops_is_entered_once_more_for_every_pair_left stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cell/session.py. The claim was "When `_apply_criterion_probes` cannot enter its gate-only cell, or the cell stops part-way with a `runtime.CellRuntimeError`, it enters a fresh gate-only cell once more, unless no pair is left to ask. It enters it only after the cell before it is torn down, through `critic_cell` with the same keywords and the same `created` set. The fresh cell asks every pair not yet answered, in order. Four stops are driven. The mutator raising as it applies a pair's edit for its witness ask asks that pair again in the fresh cell. So does the `tests` gate raising at a pair's witness ask, and so does a survivor's line read raising. A raise at a survivor's second ask files that survivor's finding once, with its witness-ask claim, and the fresh cell starts at the next pair. When that survivor is the last pair, no fresh cell is entered. A cell that cannot be entered at all has every pair asked in the fresh one. A pair the fresh cell answers carries no `unasked` key.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_session.py::test_a_second_stop_files_every_pair_left_as_an_error_naming_the_runtime_error, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
